name: What should I check before booking a bathroom door frame repair?

mainEntity.name: What should I check before booking a bathroom door frame repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting a contractor, take a few clear photos of the damaged frame, the hinges, and where the jamb meets the floor. Check whether the door currently closes, latches, or rubs against the frame, and note whether there are signs of active leaks from nearby tubs, toilets, or supply lines. Determine if you have leftover trim paint from previous interior work, and confirm whether you want to reuse your existing door slab or upgrade to a new door style. Having these details ready helps the contractor quickly determine whether a repair patch or full frame installation is necessary.
acceptedAnswer.description: Note whether the door rubs or latches, check for active water leaks, take clear photos of the frame and floor, and verify if you have matching trim paint.
